senses.gloss:
Kikkaka
a. of some Valabhi charters d. from 154 to 160 A. D.
See “Skt. an. Pkt. poets known from Inscriptions”, J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni., Baroda, VII. p. 79.

Kīka
of Lāṭakula, son of Malla, a minister an. son of Krūra.
--Budhavaktramaṇḍana. Prahelikās in 37 verses. Bikaner 3274.
On the basis of the above ms., ed. in J. G. Jhā. Res. Inst. VI. (1948-9) p.. 289-93.

Kīka
son of Nārayaṇa.
--C.. on Śaṁkara's C. on Īsāº Up. Dāhilakṣmī XXVII. 22 (inc.).

Kīka
or kIkAdatta son of Gaṅga.
--Īśābhāṣya ? See NCC. II. p. 269b.
Agnihotramantraprakāśa, Baroda 11976. See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 47b.

Kīkā
minister of Cālukya king Bhīmasena an. patron of a. of Saddharmacintāmaṇi, RASB. III. 1923.

Kīkarāja
son of Sajjana an. belonging to Kapola-vaṁśa; calls himself Śāradānandana (Intro. v. 3). [Page166-b]
--Saṁgītasāroddhāra, in 7 chs. BORI. 838 of 1886-92. BORI. D. XII. 332. Peters. IV. p. 32 (no. 838). Extr. p. 42.
See also V. Raghavan, J. of the Music Academy, Madras, IV. p. 65. Sangeet Natak Akadami Bulletin, Delhi, No. 17, p. 21.
